PRIVACY NOTICE

Effective Date: July 1, 2026
Last Updated: July 1, 2026

Marrowbone Fitness, Inc. ("we", "us", "our") operates the Marrowbone mobile application and the website at marrowbonefitness.com (together, the "Services"). This Privacy Notice explains what personal information we collect, how we use and disclose it, and the choices and rights you have. It applies to residents of every U.S. state and supplements any notice we give you at the point of collection.

1. Personal Information We Collect

In the twelve months before the Effective Date, we collected the following categories of personal information:

Identifiers — name, email address, postal address, telephone number, account username, device identifier, and IP address. Collected from you and automatically from your device. Retained for the life of your account and for 24 months after you close it.

Customer records — billing address and payment card information (processed by our payment processor; we store only the last four digits and expiration date). Collected from you. Retained for 7 years to meet tax and accounting requirements.

Commercial information — classes booked, equipment purchased, subscription tier, and cancellation history. Collected from you and generated by your use of the Services. Retained for 5 years.

Internet activity — pages viewed, features used, session duration, crash logs, and referring URL. Collected automatically. Retained for 25 months.

Geolocation data — approximate location derived from IP address, and precise location from your device only if you grant permission. Collected automatically or from you. Retained for 13 months.

Health and fitness information — heart rate, workout duration, step count, weight, and body measurements you enter or sync from a connected device. Collected from you. Retained for the life of your account. This is sensitive personal information.

Inferences — a fitness-goal profile and class recommendations drawn from the categories above. Generated by us. Retained for the life of your account.

2. Sources

We collect personal information directly from you, automatically from your device and browser, from connected fitness devices and apps you authorize, from our payment processor, and from our studio partners when you book a class through them.

3. Purposes

We use personal information to provide and operate the Services, process payments, schedule and confirm classes, personalize workout recommendations, provide customer support, send service and marketing communications, detect and prevent fraud and abuse, maintain the security and integrity of the Services, comply with law, and perform analytics to improve the Services. We do not use or disclose sensitive personal information for purposes other than those permitted under applicable law.

4. Disclosure

In the twelve months before the Effective Date, we disclosed each category above to service providers and contractors who perform services on our behalf — cloud hosting, payment processing, customer support, email delivery, analytics, and crash reporting — under written contracts that limit their use of the information to performing those services.

We share identifiers, internet activity, geolocation data, and inferences with advertising partners for cross-context behavioral advertising. We do not sell personal information for money. Under several state laws this sharing is treated as a "sale" or as "targeted advertising", and you may opt out as described in Section 6.

We do not knowingly collect or process the personal information of consumers under 16 years of age.

We may also disclose personal information to comply with law or legal process, to respond to a lawful request from a public authority, to protect our rights and the safety of our users, and to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets.

5. Retention

We retain each category for the period stated in Section 1, or for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes in Section 3, whichever is longer, and then delete or deidentify it. Where a longer period is required by law, we retain it for that period.

6. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to: know what personal information we have collected and the categories of sources, purposes, and recipients; access a portable copy; correct inaccurate personal information; delete personal information; opt out of targeted advertising, the sale or sharing of personal information, and profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects; and limit the use and disclosure of sensitive personal information.

To exercise a right, submit a request at marrowbonefitness.com/privacy-request, email privacy@marrowbonefitness.com, or call 1-800-555-0143. We will verify your identity by matching the information in your request against the information in your account, and we may ask for additional information if we cannot verify you with what we have.

We will confirm receipt within 10 business days and respond within 45 calendar days. We may extend that period by an additional 45 days where reasonably necessary, and we will tell you why within the first 45 days.

You may use an authorized agent to submit a request on your behalf. We will ask the agent for written permission signed by you and may ask you to verify your own identity directly with us.

You may also opt out of targeted advertising and the sale or sharing of personal information by clicking "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" in the footer of our website or in the app's Privacy settings, or by sending a Global Privacy Control signal from your browser, which we honor as a valid opt-out request.

We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of these rights. We do not deny goods or services, charge a different price, or provide a different level of quality because you exercised a right.

If we deny your request, you may appeal by emailing appeals@marrowbonefitness.com with the words "Privacy Appeal" in the subject line. We will respond to an appeal within 45 days and, if we deny it, tell you how to contact your state attorney general.

7. Security

We maintain administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect personal information, including encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, and regular security testing. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

8. Changes

We may update this Privacy Notice. We will post the updated notice with a new Effective Date and, where required by law, notify you directly.
